newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: India awards aviation gasoline/SKO tender to Vitol.
newsitem.headline: India awards aviation gasoline/SKO tender to Vitol.

text.p: State-owned Indian Oil Corp (IOC) has awarded a tender to buy aviation gasoline and superior kerosene oil to Dutch trader Vitol, industry sources said on Monday.
IOC's tender to buy 1,800-tonnes of avaition gasoline was awarded at around $1.85 per barrel premium to Mediterranean gasoline quotes on a free-on-board (fob) basis, but this was not confirmed.
The tender for the supply of 18,000-tonnes of superior kerosene at $5.20 per barrel premium to Mediterranean quotes fob.
The cargoes are sold on the basis that they would be lifted to arrive at the east coast port of Budge Budge in mid-January.
